name: MCM Engineering II, Inc
old_description: For over 25 years we've specialized in building custom made Switchgear
about:
MCM Engineering II, Inc., operating as LS Electric Utah, is based in Enoch, Utah. The company has specialized in custom switchgear manufacturing for more than 25 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. It operates as a subsidiary of a larger parent organization, though the parent company is not named in available materials.

The firm designs and builds medium‑voltage metal‑clad and metal‑enclosed switchgear that meets ANSI C37.20.1, C37.20.2, and C37.20.3/4 standards. Its product range covers NEMA 1 and NEMA 3R lineups, paralleling switchgear, substations, integrated power stations, utility metering equipment, severe‑environment enclosures, sheltered‑aisle walk‑ins, power distribution centers, and low‑voltage (480 V) assemblies. All work is performed in‑house through integrated design, fabrication, wiring, and assembly departments, with each project assigned a dedicated project manager and mechanical designer.

Primary customers include electric utilities, industrial plants, and commercial contractors requiring custom power‑distribution solutions. The company cites utility metering gear, substation integration, and paralleling switchgear for generator sets as typical applications.

MCM II emphasizes direct engineering access — bypassing layers of bureaucracy — and a commitment to faster turnaround than industry averages. Its shipping and loading processes are also ISO‑certified, reflecting a focus on quality through final delivery.
